style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で同じ画像を共用。外見・年代は今回の美術設定で、原文の既定情報ではない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG, delivered as a PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the person. Single adult character, centered waist-up composition, complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, lower edge below the belt, generous empty transparent margins at both sides and above. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen, worn leather and subtle brass, clean readable facial features, muted earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. The whole surrounding area is fully empty transparency, including the space beside the shoulders and head. Plain unlettered clothing surfaces. Subject: Ger, an oil supplier in his late fifties, a stocky man with thinning swept-back steel-grey hair, a high forehead, broad cheekbones, a neatly trimmed grey moustache and alert dark brown eyes. His expression is worried but candid and dignified, his eyebrows slightly raised as he explains a mistake. He wears a practical deep teal wool merchant coat, a warm tan waistcoat, an ivory linen shirt and a loosely knotted brown neckcloth, all modestly worn. His two empty hands rest loosely near his waist, one palm slightly open in a hesitant conversational gesture. His broad rounded silhouette, grey moustache and teal coat create a distinct identity.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。ゲル、油の納入商。50代後半の恰幅のよい男性。薄くなった鋼灰色の髪を後ろへ流し、広い額、張った頬骨、整えた灰色の口ひげ、注意深い濃い茶色の目。失敗を説明する心配と率直さがあり、尊厳を保った表情で眉をわずかに上げる。深い青緑色の実務的な毛織の上着、黄褐色のベスト、生成りの麻シャツ、茶色の首布を着用し、いずれも使い込んだ風合い。空の両手を腰のそばに置き、片方の掌を控えめに開く。頭と両手が入り、帯の下で自然に終わる1024×1536の縦構図。質感のある彩色人物画、落ち着いた土色、左上からの柔らかい暖色光。衣服は無地。頭や肩の周囲は完全な透過。
